subject: Brightline EU POC CAIQ: consolidated evidence zipper and control handoff
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@brightline.health>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: CAIQ - Brightline EU POC: control mapping + evidence zipper

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. To keep momentum with our EU POC (private VPC deployment), the security team asked that we submit a single CAIQ workbook plus a consolidated evidence "zipper" (zipped artifacts + a manifest CSV) that maps each CAIQ control to the specific artifact(s) and owner.

I attached our initial CAIQ mapping (Brightline_CAIQ_2028.xlsx) with a few comments in the document where the scope is ambiguous. Scope for the POC is: private deployment in eu-west-1, customer-managed KMS, and audit window = last 6 months.

Can Redwood provide: 
- A clean, filled CAIQ (column-level responses)
- One zipped evidence bundle with a manifest (csv) that lists artifact filename, control ref, owner, and short proof description
- A Drive link where we can preview before we circulate to our security reviewers

Target: have the CAIQ + evidence bundle ready for initial review by Apr 7 (Brightline security needs time to run a quick sanity check). Do you need anything else from our side?

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Rossi
Head of Security Operations
Brightline Health
elena@brightline.health
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@brightline.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - Brightline EU POC: control mapping + evidence zipper

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for the workbook. Attaching a quick plan below and an initial manifest stub (evidence-zipper-manifest.csv) that we'll populate as we collect artifacts.

Plan (summary):
1) Redwood will return a completed CAIQ (we'll populate the response column and add control notes) — target Mar 31 for first pass.
2) Evidence zipper: we will collect artifacts from the infra and product teams, generate a manifest.csv with fields: artifact, control_ref, owner, description, retention_path.
3) Delivery: upload ZIP + manifest to a shared Drive folder and post a short review note.

Owners (initial):
- Infra proofs (KV/caching, network config, runtime telemetry): Jordan Blake
- KMS/key rotation proof + HSM attestations: Marissa Cole
- Service-level configs (routing, tenancy): Neha Kapoor (I'll coordinate)

Next steps: Jordan and Marissa, can you confirm you can start pulling the infra proofs today and drop artifacts into the shared folder Marissa will create? I will reconcile the CAIQ entries against Brightline_CAIQ_2028.xlsx and flag any items that need clarification.

Attachments: evidence-zipper-manifest.csv (stub)

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@brightline.health>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - Brightline EU POC: control mapping + evidence zipper

Thanks Neha — I've created the shared folder and seeded it with a few artifacts we already have that match Brightline's scope. Link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExAMPLE-SharedFolder

Folder structure (high level):
- 01_CAIQ_filled/ (CAIQ drafts and final)
- 02_Infrastructure/ (network diagrams, subnet lists, security group snapshots)
- 03_Keys_and_KMS/ (kms-rotation-proof.pdf, KMS policy extract)
- 04_Runtime_Telemetry/ (traces, sample logs)
- 05_Manifest/ (evidence-zipper-manifest.csv)

I've attached kms-rotation-proof.pdf (stub) to this message for quick reference. Estimated timeline: we can populate the manifest and upload the initial ZIP by Mar 31, but Jordan will need until Apr 3 to include full telemetry samples (size and redaction take time).

I'll set permissions to allow Brightline security preview access (view only) and will drop a short readme in the folder describing redaction rules.

Marissa
Sr. Evidence Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>

On Tue, 27 Mar 2028 at 11:02, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> I've created the shared folder and seeded it with a few artifacts we already have that match Brightline's scope.

Confirmed — I'll collect the infra artifacts today and start pushing to the 02_Infrastructure and 04_Runtime_Telemetry folders. Items I'll include:
- network diagram (vpc-subnet-mapping.png)
- security group and NACL snapshots (sgs_202803.zip)
- runtime-telemetry-sample.log (redacted; includes request ids for traceability)
- kv-cache-prefix-sample.txt (shows prefix caching behavior and retention)

If Brightline needs raw logs instead of samples for any specific control, flag the control_ref and we'll coordinate a secure transfer.

Jordan

Neha / team — this looks perfect, thanks. Brightline security appreciates the folder and the manifest template. We'll aim to review the package by Apr 10 internally and will raise any clarifying questions via the manifest (control_ref column).

One procurement note: if everything looks good on our side we'll need a DocuSign-ready statement of access for the POC (SLA/retention appendix). Can you add a placeholder doc to the 01_CAIQ_filled folder so our procurement can start redlining?

Thanks again — Elena
